Artificial intelligence is changing the world.
s1
But behind every AI breakthrough is one incredibly important piece of technology.
s1
Inside these powerful machines are advanced processors designed to handle billions of calculations.
s2
Companies like NVIDIA design the technology, while manufacturers like TSMC produce the advanced chips.
s3
These chips power data centers, artificial intelligence systems and technologies used around the world.
s4
And demand for them is exploding.
s5
In its latest quarter, NVIDIA's revenue reached one hundred fifteen point eight billion dollars, more than double a year earlier.
s5
Data center chips alone brought in one hundred seven point six billion.
s5
And for the next quarter, NVIDIA expects about one hundred thirty billion dollars.
s5
As demand for artificial intelligence grows, the companies behind these chips are becoming increasingly important.
